vson_p:
# Persona (v1.1) — cross-document identity carrier.
# Demonstrates: Persona node + hasInvariant Quality + entity embodies Persona.
# Same Persona may be embodied by different entities across scenes; invariants
# (eye color, build) are stable, while hasQuality (mood, pose) is per-scene.

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle eye_level :focalLength 50mm :framing medium_shot)
   :viewedBy cam

   :framedBy (alice_persona / Persona
                :hasInvariant (pi1 / Quality :dimension Hair :value blonde_long)
                :hasInvariant (pi2 / Quality :dimension Skin :value light)
                :hasInvariant (pi3 / Quality :dimension Role :value queen))

   :depicts (alice / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Named :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Human
               :embodies alice_persona
               :hasQuality (a1 / Quality :dimension Affect :value joyful)
               :hasQuality (a2 / Quality :dimension Pose   :value seated)))
vson_t:
@prefix vso:   <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#> .
@prefix allen: <https://vson.dev/v1/allen#> .
@prefix rcc:   <https://vson.dev/v1/rcc8#> .

:alice <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#countability> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Count> .
:alice <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#class> :Human .

:a1 a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Quality> .

:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#depicts> :alice .
